many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

code='''def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[[7]*w for _ in range(h)]
    zeros=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==0]
    rows={r for r,c in zeros}; cols={c for r,c in zeros}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==9 and not any(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))):
                out[r][c]=9
    vertical=len(rows)>len(cols)
    if vertical:
        top=sum(r<3 for r,c in zeros); bottom=sum(r>=h-3 for r,c in zeros)
        src=list(range(3)) if top>bottom else list(range(h-3,h))
        dst=list(range(h-3,h)) if top>bottom else list(range(3))
        for sr,dr in zip(src,dst): out[dr]=grid[sr][:]
    else:
        left=sum(c<3 for r,c in zeros); right=sum(c>=w-3 for r,c in zeros)
        src=list(range(3)) if left>right else list(range(w-3,w))
        dst=list(range(w-3,w)) if left>right else list(range(3))
        for sc,dc in zip(src,dst):
            for r in range(h): out[r][dc]=grid[r][sc]
    return out
'''
